title: Sustaining of General Authorities, Area Seventies, and General Officers
author: Presented by President Dallin H. Oaks
author_raw: Presented by President Dallin H. Oaks
calling_raw: First Counselor in the First Presidency
notes_text: 1.  These General Authority Seventies have turned or will turn 70 years of age this year. As is the usual practice, they will therefore be released from their assignments and given emeritus status, effective on August 1, 2025.
